items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How do you like Sammy Stoner? Fine. [INTERVIEWEE] Fine.

ctx.x: Well, all Dixieland bands to me compare the same way. They all gonna play the same numbers. They go, oh, it's always gonna give you that Dixieland beat. You know, you just sit down there and follow the drummer, that's all.
How do you like Sammy Stoner? Fine.
